knowledge_gaps: The idea is suitable as a controlled experiment, but reproduction requires the supplied baseline’s terminal-branch probability, training-window construction, random-mask policy, loss denominator, and checkpoint-selection rule. These cannot be established from external references.

Terminal masking and appended-MASK inference must use consistent context truncation and positional indices. The pseudocode does not establish this correspondence, including handling empty or single-item histories.

The target-share formula describes pooled target counts approximately; it does not establish the expected optimization contribution when batches have varying denominators. Report actual branch contributions under the implemented reduction.

Changing branch probability also changes supervised-target volume at fixed training steps. Any improvement would support the allocation intervention as a whole, without isolating training–inference alignment as its cause.

Originality 3 is reasonable. Potential 7 remains speculative, and difficulty 2 describes the sampler edit but understates baseline verification and bookkeeping. Keep alternative normalization and perturbation ideas separate from this experiment.

Prespecify comparison with the corrected cold start, report each category’s validation HR@10 and the macro difference, and acknowledge uncertainty from 200 users per category and one training seed. Repeated validation selection can overfit; no improvement or shortcut learning is established yet.
